generate_dummy_code_pybind11: generate dummy C++ pybind11 binding code for a given number of classes with random functions
generate_dummy_code_boost: generate dummy C++ Boost.Python binding code for a given number of classes with random functions
run_benchmark_pybind11: run the pybind11 compilation benchmark by importing the module and measuring build times across class counts
run_benchmark_boost: run the Boost.Python compilation benchmark by importing the module and measuring build times across class counts
review_benchmark_setup: review the benchmark configuration variables nfns and nargs that control functions per class and arguments per function
